MANDARIN MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MANDARIN MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
